prompt:
bench: the plan, tools/ and card do not exist here; everything is below; return only the draft path.

You are the phase planner for the shelf project. This directory is the project: `GENERATION_PLAN.md` (generation 1, six phases), `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`, `HOW_WE_WORK.md`, `PHASE_SEED.md` (the phase-plan template and its task-line grammar), `shelf/` the package and `tests/` its suite. There is no `phase-ends/` and no plan tool; read the files directly.

Draft the phase plan for phase 1.2 (Open days) and write it to `.run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`. The draft's Milestone line carries phase 1.2's milestone clauses; every clause must be covered by some task whose `done-when:` or `verify:` names what the clause names; every task line has `files:` and a runnable `verify:`. Do not write any other file and do not start the work.

Return only one line: `DRAFT: .run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`.

milestone.clause: `business_days_between` and `add_business_days` skip weekends and holidays (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_business_days`)
`LoanDesk` takes `holidays` and every due date from checkout or renew falls on `next_open_day` (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_due_open_days`)
the whole suite stays green (verified by: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`)

rubric_items: `business_days_between` and `add_business_days` are added to shelf/dates.py, skip weekends (is_weekend) and a given set of holiday dates, and are tested in tests/test_business_days.py.
`next_open_day` returns the day itself when it is open, else the next weekday that is not a holiday; the existing next_business_day (strictly after, no holidays) is not reused unchanged.
LoanDesk takes `holidays` with a default of none, so existing callers and storage.loads keep working unchanged.
Both checkout's due date and renew's extended due date pass through next_open_day.
business_days_between defines and tests its edge cases (end before start, start or end on a closed day).
Due-date tests pin the desk's clock and cover a due date on a weekend and on a holiday (tests/test_due_open_days.py).
The per-kind loan periods in shelf/policy.py stay as they are; only the due date moves to an open day.
The last task or the milestone check runs `python -m unittest discover -s tests`.
